title: Phase 7 pre-registration: RAG v1 vs v2 on the frozen evaluation set

excluded.EV-06: exposed in Phase 6; retrieval-only sensitivity check, reported separately, never in totals

fixed_settings.relevance: chunk fully contains a required canonical fact (evaluation.metrics / retrieval_metrics)

part_a_retrieval.configs: all 18 (3 chunkings x dense/bm25/hybrid x rerank off/on)
metrics: context coverage (the <=4 chunks after the dense filter)
part_a_retrieval.aggregation: macro over the 25 answerable queries; unanswerable excluded from retrieval metrics

part_b_answers.manual_review: failed items reviewed afterwards and classified; reported separately, never changes the deterministic numbers

selection_rule: primary: correct answers (25 answerable) + correct refusals (5) = score out of 30
comparison: per-query paired wins/losses/ties of each v2 config vs v1 on 'correct'; exact two-sided sign test (ties excluded)
no_tuning: no prompt, threshold, chunking, BM25, RRF, reranker or answer-key change after registration
